title: Flight-Sim Landing Smoothness Score
dataSources: Pilot logbook (`flightlog:entry`), avionics telemetry (`avionics:telemetry`), flight-sim sessions (`flightsim:session`), pre-flight checklists (`preflight:check`).
app: Pilot and flight-sim telemetry — electronic logbooks (ForeFlight, LogTen Pro), Stratux / GDL90 avionics receivers, and Microsoft Flight Simulator / X-Plane SimConnect sessions — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flightsim:session event=landing
| eval grade=case(touchdown_fpm>-100,"butter",touchdown_fpm>-300,"good",touchdown_fpm>-600,"firm",1=1,"hard")
| stats count as landings by grade
| sort grade
description: Grades your flight-sim landings by touchdown rate, turning greaser hunting into a tracked skill.
value: A landing-quality breakdown makes sim practice measurable and genuinely transfers to smoother real approaches.
implementation: Ingest SimConnect landing events into `index=personal`; grade landings by descent rate.
visualization: Bar chart of flight-sim landings by smoothness grade.
grandmaExplanation: It grades how smoothly you land in the flight simulator, turning practice into a fun skill to improve.
